title: ArchiSurance
meta: Insurance pack, built from the Archi sample model
blurb: A fictional EU insurer with home and travel, car and legal aid products. Applications, platforms, roles, interfaces and processes come from the ArchiSurance sample that ships with Archi; costs, contracts and ratings are illustrative. Includes a back-office consolidation programme.
attribution: The Archi model is Copyright (c) 2013-2026 Phillip Beauvoir, Jean-Baptiste Sarrodie, The Open Group, used under the MIT licence. ArchiSurance is a fictional company created by The Open Group. Everything added to it in this atlas is illustrative.
